content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened initially, based on the screening, only the shortlisted applicants will be called for an online interview via online mode. Mere fulfilment of minimum eligibility will not bestow the right for shortlisting. IIT Dharwad reserves the right to screen and shortlist candidates by introducing higher benchmarks. Emails will be sent to all shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Dharwad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Dharwad is 02 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow at IIT Dharwad?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Junior Research Fellow position in the latest recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad. This is a project-based research opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Dharwad is online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the designated online portal before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Dharwad?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, along with an additional 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA). This compensation is for the project-based role.

faq.question: Q5. What are the age limit criteria for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position should not exceed 35 years of age as on the date of the selection process. Age relaxation rules, if any, would be as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech./M.S./M.E. or equivalent in relevant engineering fields, or a B.Tech./B.E. with a valid GATE/UGC/CSIR NET JRF/LS score, or an M.Sc. in Physics/Electronics with a valid GATE/UGC/CSIR NET JRF/LS score.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications. Shortlisted candidates will then be called for an online interview. IIT Dharwad reserves the right to set higher benchmarks for shortlisting candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the complete notification before applying to understand all details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow position is Dharwad, Karnataka. The selected candidate will be working at the Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad campus for the duration of the project.
